subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this PR retain a workflow-wide `PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false` override after confirming that every CI job which invokes pnpm has explicit dependency setup, rather than scoping the override to the racing boundary jobs?
rationale: The Signal repair is mechanical, but disabling pnpm’s dependency check globally changes CI recovery semantics beyond the reported shard race; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Verify and retain the global override
options.body: Document or test that every pnpm-running CI job has a preceding authoritative dependency setup, then retain the global setting to prevent parallel auto-install races.

options.title: Scope the override to affected jobs
options.body: Move the setting to only the boundary jobs proven to race if full workflow coverage cannot be established.

options.title: Pause the CI change
options.body: Land a Signal-only follow-up and investigate the dependency race separately if the global CI contract remains uncertain.

recommendation.title: Verify and retain the global override
recommendation.body: Document or test that every pnpm-running CI job has a preceding authoritative dependency setup, then retain the global setting to prevent parallel auto-install races.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workflow history and this branch’s CI changes make steipete the strongest available owner for the intended CI behavior.
